content.text: Memory climbs steadily while traffic stays flat at 1200 and no change was recorded, so this is a resource leak. The process start time never changes, so no restart explains it either.

hypotheses.summary: Memory in io-shop climbs steadily from about 15:09 with flat traffic (1200 rpm), no deployment, no config change and constant CPU limit. Heap grows without being released, and latency degrades once memory passes ~1GiB. This is a leak in the running process. The ClientDisconnected errors are baseline noise and predate the incident.

supporting_evidence.claim: memory_used_bytes 466915519 at 15:08 rising to 1398515098 at 15:37 with request_volume constant at 1200 and cpu_limit_cores constant at 3.0
WARN io-shop: heap at 1053MiB of 2048MiB limit, rising ~30MiB per minute to 1323MiB
get_changes: nothing changed in this window; rollout converged, no deployment history
p99_ms rose from ~376 to 1288 as heap grew; the ClientDisconnected errors were present before the onset
